title: Acquire sector-labelled Slaters from an actual Gaussian covariance
statement: Diagonalizing a supplied gauge-invariant covariance C0 and sampling independent eigenmode occupations gives the same Gaussian density as a mixture of pure Slaters. If C0 commutes with all diagonal charges, common-block diagonalization gives known charge q per sampled Slater; the same C vectors/cone are used and the one-body gauge correction depends on that sampled q.

requires: Known density interaction U, warranted PSD physical dephasing and exactly preserved diagonal charges C^T n=q
A supplied fixed-sector Slater or efficiently sampled Gaussian mixture commuting with the same charge blocks
An actual PSD covariance witness, positive state-dependent outcome sampling and paid matrix/precision/observable costs
provides: A paid initialization route for the sector sampler
assumptions: Not a decomposition oracle for arbitrary interacting thermal or charge-coherent BCS states
Sampling law and covariance are supplied, not acquired by existence of a Gaussian-mixture theorem
costs: SDP/gauge/covariance factorization, Gaussian and occupation draws, conditional Slater updates and QR/conditioning
The64-mode512-trajectory120-cycle target is Floquet, not a continuous-H product-formula approximation
For a separately requested noncommuting continuous H0+interaction generator, product-formula error is an additional obligation
contract.units: Dimensionless probabilities/Bell loss/half-diamond error as explicitly stated; source calls, resets, memory and control gates are separate costs.
contract.obstruction: A representation theorem does not automatically supply a usable initial-state sampling interface.

evidence.quote: ACQUIRING THE REQUIRED FIXED-CHARGE GAUSSIAN INPUT
evidence.range_scope: Governing producer statement; retain the complete source contract and review scope.

body: Author/root construction with independent cone review pending. Exact charges, supplied physical noise and a sampled Gaussian input law are substantive. The restricted optimizer is not complete over all support identities: a one-particle sector already removes all off-diagonal occupation interactions at zero noise even when its ansatz threshold is positive. The actual global-feedback incumbent and only-reported dual-rail Gaussian-mixture threshold are retained; that is a representation boundary, not classical hardness. Routine Gaussian refinement was parked in the delivered parent context. Read the exact supporting statement and its applicable conditions. Producer review status is preserved; no new scientific audit or producer-code execution was performed for this insertion.

review.scope: Interim author/root derivation; independent cone review pending; no practical advantage established.
